name: J. W. Tompkins
role: Billings County candidate and rancher down the river, 1886
bio: J. W. Tompkins appeared on both the Billings County ticket and the Stockmen's ticket in March 1886, and his name was among the results of the April 1886 county election. In June 1886 he went down the river on a bear hunt, and in October 1886 he moved his family into the house formerly occupied by Mrs. O'Hara, while Mike Knott traded his store building for Tompkins' ranch down the river.
